context:
Pilot attempt 2 (claude.ai/code web session, BenchBox-dev/benchbox attached): first-minute checks PASSED (origin present, fetch develop at 8a64bcf5, dry-run push accepted). Builder stopped at make cloud-bootstrap per cloud-builder.md, no edits/commits. Blocker 1: node 22.22.0 in image; markdownlint hook needs ^22.22.2/^24.15.0/>=26. Blocker 2: tailscale/tailscaled not installed, so gateway=unavailable and make pr-open would refuse before push. Both are owner env prerequisites already listed in docs/agent/cloud-builder.md (Environment setup, Oracle gateway access). Session git identity was Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>; BENCHBOX_GIT_NAME/EMAIL are set so bootstrap should pin the human identity; builder must verify before commit. Setup time ~9 min incl clone. Next: owner updates the environment setup script (draft at /tmp/cloud-env-setup.sh, untested; needs network allowlist for nodejs.org, astral.sh, pkgs.tailscale.com), starts a NEW session, reruns same prompt. Claim retained.

Correction after reading code.claude.com/docs/en/cloud-environments: (1) setup scripts run as root BEFORE environment variables are set, so make cloud-bootstrap must NOT be in the setup script (it needs BENCHBOX_GIT_NAME/EMAIL); the builder runs it per cloud-builder.md. docs/agent/cloud-builder.md says to run bootstrap in the setup script and may need a docs correction. (2) uv and Node 20/21/22 are preinstalled (node22 = 22.22.0); nodejs.org is in the Trusted allowlist; pkgs.tailscale.com is not, so network access must be Custom with default list plus Tailscale hosts and build.stencil.so (OMP pin host). (3) Anthropic GitHub proxy rejects GraphQL (gh pr/issue subcommands 403); BenchBox make pr-open uses REST so should be OK, unverified. (4) Script must exit zero and finish under ~5 min to be cached. Revised draft at /tmp/cloud-env-setup.sh (untested): installs Node 24 + Tailscale only.

Pilot attempt 4: node blocker fixed (builder reports node v24.22.2). make cloud-bootstrap now refuses on uv: image has 0.11.32, pyproject.toml [tool.uv] required-version >=0.13.4. Builder stopped without edits. Setup ~14s to refusal. Fix: ~/cloud-env-setup.sh now installs uv>=0.13.4 from PyPI into /opt/uv-venv and links over the existing uv (untested). Tailscale install and gateway reachability not yet exercised. UV_NATIVE_TLS deprecation warning (use UV_SYSTEM_CERTS) is warning-only. docs/agent/cloud-builder.md Environment setup should also list the uv minimum.
description: The repository's type checker reports invalid-return-type in _resolved_git_identity at _project/scripts/agent_instruction_audit.py: the function promises tuple[str, str], while re.Match.groups() is inferred as a variadic tuple containing optional strings. The warning reproduces on origin/develop and was not introduced by the anchor-whitespace change. Log it separately rather than hiding it in an unrelated PR.
